crossRefs.note: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess…
The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gershom
people.line: Descendant of Phinehas; returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

people.name: Hattush
people.line: A descendant of David, who returned from exile.

people.name: Ithamar
people.line: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.

people.name: Phinehas
people.line: Aaron's grandson; zealous priest who opposed idolatry
